chunks: Immunity is granted by God and His Apostle to those idolaters with whom you have a treaty.

key_terms.بَرَاءَةٌ: Immunity or declaration of freedom from obligation
key_terms.عَاهَدْتُم: You have made a treaty or covenant

ai.seo_question: What does the verse of Immunity (Bara'ah) signify regarding the treaty with the polytheists?
ai.summary: Known as the 'Verse of Immunity' (Āyat al-Barā'ah), this verse was recited by Ali ibn Abi Talib in the presence of Abu Bakr during the Hajj of 9 AH to ensure the treaty's termination was proclaimed with authority. It marks a pivotal transition in early Islamic history, shifting from the period of treaty-based coexistence to the consolidation of Muslim political and spiritual sovereignty in Mecca.
